traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.text: The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The goblin makes two attacks with its scimitar. The second attack has disadvantage.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6) piercing damage.
